Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

11. Deputation (Duty) Allowance drawn while on deputation with another department of the Government will not count as emoluments for pension. - Section I, Appendix-5.
4. Maximum age-limit in case of appointment by deputation /
12. deputation (including short-term contract).-
6. (i) For posts in the SAC level and above (i.e. Level-14 of the Pay Matrix and above):Not exceeding fifty-eight years as on the closing date of receipt of application.
